headline: Glycolic Acid 8% in a PM routine
footnote: Day and week labels mark routine stages, not study timings. AI illustrations, not real results.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a pure white seamless paper backdrop, soft daylight from the upper left, a faint grey contact-shadow area on the right. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty space, evenly lit, for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left half as a calm empty area for copy. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.

caption: Glycolic Acid 8% Exfoliating Liquid: Take a few drops into your palms and gently press into skin; PM. Start with twice a week and increase gradually; do not use more than once a day. The frames are AI illustrations of a routine, not study results.

frames_prompt: Three equal panels of the same Indian woman in her early 30s with light-brown skin, an identical close crop of the cheek and forehead in every panel, same framing, angle and soft daylight from the upper left. Concern: a slightly dull-looking tone. Panel 1: slightly dull; panels 2 and 3: very slightly more even-looking each time. The change is small and realistic, never dramatic. In every panel the lower-right corner (about 30% of the panel width and 40% of its height) is a plain, softly lit area that is intentionally empty, reserved for the real pack to be placed later.
